value.rationale: Fixing players is a native intervention in current conformist-rebel-stubborn network models. The result solves the minimum possible stabilization cost for a nontrivial two-community antagonistic topology, exhibits a zero-to-linear gap between weak ties and strict best-response stability, and supplies the exact finite chance a random minimal placement works; this is relevant to designing targeted commitments rather than a relabeling of the published existence theorem.
